steps_h2: How to Make an Image-to-Video Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Upload one clear product image, describe one movement and download the clip for your ad.

steps.d: Bring a still product photo to life without a reshoot. Upload one clear photo with the full product visible and key details easy to see.
Give the product one clear motion shoppers can notice. Write one sentence that tells the tool what should turn, open, pour, or change.
Add movement to your next ad in minutes. Watch the result, then download the short video for your ad, feed, or product page.

faq.q: What can image to video show?
faq.a: It adds one focused product motion such as a turn, pour, opening, or light change.

faq.q: Does image to video write a script or add audio?
faq.a: No. It animates the product image; add a script, narration, music, or captions in your editor after download.
Use a clear, well-lit photo with the full product visible and its important details in frame.

faq.q: Which video sizes can I choose?
Which clip lengths can I choose?
Can I make several ad versions from one photo?
faq.a: Yes. Change the motion or length and compare the clips while keeping the same product image.

faq.q: Can I retry a motion that looks wrong?
faq.a: Yes. Describe one simpler motion, generate another version, and check the product against the source photo.

faq.q: Where can I use the downloaded clip?
faq.a: Use it in TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or a product listing after checking each channel’s current requirements.
